mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.tenant_id, o.host_id, o.homestay_id, o.check_in_date, o.check_out_date, o.nights, o.guest_count, o.unit_price, o.total_amount, o.coupon_id, o.coupon_name, o.discount_amount, o.pay_amount, o.contact_name, o.contact_phone, o.status, o.pay_time, o.cancel_time, o.cancel_reason, o.reviewed, o.created_at, o.updated_at, h.title AS homestay_title, h.cover_img, h.city, h.address, su.real_name AS tenant_name, hu.real_name AS host_name
FROM booking_order o INNER JOIN homestay h ON h.id = o.homestay_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = o.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user hu ON hu.id = o.host_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
AND o.status = #{status}
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR su.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR su.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
SELECT check_in_date AS checkInDate, check_out_date AS checkOutDate FROM booking_order WHERE homestay_id = #{homestayId} AND status IN ('PENDING_PAY', 'PAID', 'CHECKED_IN') ORDER BY check_in_date
mapper.update: UPDATE booking_order SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_time = NOW(), cancel_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'PENDING_PAY' AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
